source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; a human opens the chassis and visually inspects jumper position/location.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; use a complete board-revision-specific designator/location/population map and keep setting verification separate in row 2285.

old_problem: The protected row did not identify the motherboard revision or complete in-scope jumper/header location and population/DNI map, and the word `position` could incorrectly import shunt-setting coverage from the adjacent Jumper check.
disposition_reason: This row's scope is physically enumerable once the exact PCB revision and signed jumper/header location map are supplied. ED-03 allows those designators, coordinates and DNI exceptions to be runtime project configuration; ED-09 assigns the no-touch chassis inspection to a qualified human. The adjacent row independently verifies shunt settings, so this record deliberately checks only presence/population, location and mechanical orientation. No further command semantics or safety decision is missing, and Pending can be removed.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Functionality rows 2284 and 2285, including row-2284 Items, Procedure, Criteria and DeepSeek fields; row 2285 is the verified next formal pending source.
Read GPT V2/historical record 2405 and retained the exact Source Key, Variant ID and row hash.
Preserve exhaustive jumper location/population coverage rather than accepting one representative photograph.
Keep row-2284 location/population identity distinct from row-2285 electrical shunt-state verification, satisfying ED-19 duplicate/similar coverage identity.
Require safe de-energized/ESD access and prohibit shunt removal, repositioning or probing.
No chassis access, jumper handling or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Complete motherboard jumper/header location and population map inspection
test_case.purpose: Verify every in-scope jumper/header reference is present or DNI exactly as specified at the correct PCB coordinate and mechanical orientation for the exact motherboard revision, without evaluating or changing its shunt setting.
required_package: SUT identity, motherboard assembly and PCB revision
Complete signed jumper/header reference-designator and coordinate map
Approved de-energized chassis access, ESD and indexed-photo procedure
test_case.test_command: A qualified operator powers down and accesses the board according to the approved service/ESD procedure, verifies motherboard/PCB revision, captures one indexed overview and a labeled close-up for every in-scope jumper/header, and reconciles designator, presence/DNI state, coordinate and mechanical orientation against the signed map. Do not touch, remove, reseat or electrically probe any shunt; restore the chassis when complete.
test_case.expected_result: Every required designator is uniquely visible at the specified coordinate with the approved population/DNI and mechanical orientation, no extra or mislocated header is present, the photo set covers the complete map, and the inspection leaves all shunts unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires a complete one-to-one reconciliation for every map entry with exact board/revision identity and traceable overview/close-up evidence. One representative jumper, a correct shunt setting without location proof, hidden/ambiguous designators, wrong PCB revision, unexplained extra/missing header or any movement is not PASS. The end engineer decides PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Use the approved de-energized/service state and ESD controls before exposing the board.
Confirm PCB revision before selecting the jumper map and DNI exceptions.
Do not move, remove, reseat or probe any jumper or header in this location-only check.
Stop on unsafe access, missing labels, suspected disturbance or inability to uniquely bind a photo to a designator.
expected_evidence: Row/variant/hash plus SUT/motherboard assembly and PCB revision
Annotated board overview with all inspected locations indexed
Per-designator close-ups showing silkscreen, coordinate landmarks and body orientation
Complete missing/extra/mislocated/DNI reconciliation and no-touch/chassis-restoration attestation
test_case.recovery: The planned inspection is non-mutating. If a header cannot be identified or appears disturbed, stop and preserve as-found photographs; any shunt correction/reseat belongs to a separately authorized maintenance action and requires its own before/after evidence.

source_conflict.reason: The protected row consistently asks for jumper location; formatting and spelling defects do not create competing scope.

blocked.reason: The exhaustive manual location/population method is defined; revision-specific map values are runtime configuration.
